mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in over 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.0 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative or flat 60d returns in more than 50% of instances despite HOUST above 1.0 million, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX achieves positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO falls below 108.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal broad-based demand strength, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 218.0 and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% signals persistent inflation and a hawkish monetary policy stance, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.0% and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150k signals a rapidly tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when both conditions are met, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 380 billion dollars combined with a rise in GDP (GDPC1) above 11700 billion signals strong aggregate demand growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX achieves negative or flat 60d returns in more than 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
